en: The image shows four men standing on the deck of a historic wooden sailing ship. They wear dark blue 17th–18th‑century style naval or military uniforms with bright blue cuffs and trim; one man in the center has yellow breeches and stockings and a broad‑brimmed hat, evoking an officer or captain. The deck is crowded with rigging, ropes, and masts, and there are people in historical costumes in the background, suggesting a reenactment or maritime festival. A blue‑and‑yellow vertical flag is visible toward the right side of the image.
